agent.reasons: Goran Rahman is a politically exposed person (PEP), which means escalation under 4.3. He is the CEO, the control person and a 23% owner. Separately, 30% of the ownership belongs to unknown holders, so one unidentified person could own 25% or more. That makes ownership incomplete and calls for requesting documents under 3.3. Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, escalate, governs. All other checks are clear: no sanctions hits, no adverse media, all IDs verified, US geography, an ordinary industry and a registry filing from April 2026.
